name: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, sells, and services in vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents in China and internationally. The company offers chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer, diabetes solution, automated biochemical analyzer, laboratory automation, tenfly phoenix blot analyzer, VISION Pro ESR analyzer, and VISION ESR analyzer. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
